summary: Tested document upload/delete functionality for PropertyIntelligencePanel and DealDetails. All backend endpoints exist and require auth. Code review verified all implementations match requirements.

backend_post_documents.details: Accepts file upload with FormData, requires auth token, verifies deal ownership or team membership

backend_get_documents.details: Returns documents list, requires auth token, verifies access (owner or same team)

backend_delete_document.details: Allows delete if user is doc uploader OR deal owner (line 208-212). Deletes from storage and database.

panel_handleDocumentUpload.details: Uses fetch POST to ${API}/deals/${data.id}/documents with FormData and auth token (not direct Supabase)

panel_fetchDocuments.details: Uses fetch GET to ${API}/deals/${data.id}/documents with auth token (not direct Supabase)

panel_handleDeleteDocument.details: Uses fetch DELETE to ${API}/documents/${docId} with auth token

panel_delete_button_ui.details: Each document row has Trash2 delete button with data-testid='delete-doc-${doc.id}' and Download button

dealdetails_handleDeleteDocument.details: Uses fetch DELETE to ${API}/documents/${docId} with auth token

dealdetails_delete_button_ui.details: Each document has Trash2 delete button with data-testid='delete-doc-${doc.id}', visible only when isOwner is true

critical_code_review_comments: PropertyIntelligencePanel.js: handleDocumentUpload (lines 289-322) correctly uses fetch POST to backend API with FormData - NOT direct Supabase storage
PropertyIntelligencePanel.js: fetchDocuments (lines 264-281) correctly uses fetch GET to backend API - NOT direct Supabase table query
PropertyIntelligencePanel.js: handleDeleteDocument (lines 324-346) correctly uses fetch DELETE to backend API
PropertyIntelligencePanel.js: Document table (lines 2516-2562) has both Download and Delete (Trash2) buttons for each document
DealDetails.js: handleDeleteDocument (lines 360-379) correctly uses fetch DELETE to backend API
DealDetails.js: Delete button (lines 1192-1205) is conditionally rendered with {isOwner && ...} check
server.py: DELETE /api/documents/{document_id} (lines 208-212) allows both doc uploader (owner_id) AND deal owner (deals.owner_id) to delete

test_credentials.note: CRM requires Supabase auth - cannot test authenticated flows without credentials

context_for_next_testing_agent: Document upload/delete functionality verified through code review and endpoint tests. PropertyIntelligencePanel now uses backend API for upload/fetch/delete (not direct Supabase). DealDetails has delete button visible only to deal owner. Backend DELETE endpoint allows both doc uploader and deal owner to delete. All data-testid attributes present for testing.
